memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent with ADLs, walks unaided around home, manages pharmacy work part‑time.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 2 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Reports occasional irritability during flare, denies depression.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "Stay symptom‑free and keep working at the pharmacy."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: ADLs independent, reports breakthrough wheals on trunk after stressful days, still manages pharmacy duties.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: One fall at home 3 months ago (tripped over rug), no injury, gait cautious, timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds (raised fall risk). Plan: home‑based strength exercises, non‑slip footwear.
medicines: 2 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS). Not polypharmacy.
mood: Mild frustration with breakthrough symptoms, denies depression.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "Achieve longer periods without hives so I can work full days."

mood: Mood good, reports improved sleep.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "Maintain control and reduce medication burden."
